newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Security summit a big snore for some.
newsitem.headline: Security summit a big snore for some.

text.p: Listening to more than 50 leaders deliver their speeches at a European security summit can be a serious challenge even for the most attentive of political ears.
Swiss President Jean-Pascal Delamuraz, seated at the long, oval table in Lisbon with other heads of state and government, stole a few seconds to catnap before addressing the meeting himself.

After gourmet Portuguese hosts had laid on a hearty VIP lunch, eagle-eyed observers spotted the Swiss leader -- still wearing his simultaneous translation earphones-- with his head back, eyes closed and jaw ajar.
Switzerland currently has the honour of chairing the 54-nation Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE)
